title: Earnings Gap
briefing: Nimbus Cloud and Meadow Pharma both report this month. The calendar tells you when; the surprise will tell you which way.
objective: Earnings: keep size small into the report, react to the surprise and guidance, and watch for the excitement fading.
debrief: Nimbus Cloud beat and raised guidance on day 12 and gapped up, but much of the jump faded over the next two weeks as early buyers took profits after the analyst day on day 20. Meadow Pharma missed and cut its outlook on day 18 and kept sliding. A disciplined player went into each report small, bought the beat after it was confirmed, took profits when the move stalled and avoided the miss.

assets.name: Nimbus Cloud
assets.blurb: Rents cloud servers and storage to businesses.

news.headline: Nimbus Cloud reports on day 12, Meadow Pharma on day 18
news.body: Analysts expect solid growth from Nimbus and flat sales from Meadow.

news.headline: Nimbus Cloud beats estimates and raises guidance
news.body: Sales grew 34% against 28% expected, and the company lifted its forecast.

news.headline: Meadow Pharma misses estimates and cuts its outlook
news.body: A generic rival took more market share than expected.

news.headline: Nimbus Cloud analyst day brings no new targets
news.body: Management repeated its forecast; some investors had hoped for more.

bonus.text: Keep Nimbus Cloud at 20% or less going into its day-12 report
Take profits on Nimbus Cloud within 9 days of its report
Keep Meadow Pharma at 20% or less going into its day-18 report
